name: Megaliths of Carnac and of the shores of Morbihan
description: Along Brittany's southern coast, more than 3,000 granite standing stones march across the fields around Carnac in long, straight rows, forming the largest such collection in the world. Raised some 5,000 to 6,500 years ago, they stand beside burial mounds and stone tombs, with more at Locmariaquer and on islands like Gavrinis in the Gulf of Morbihan. Local legend says they are a Roman legion turned to stone by Merlin.
